create_histogram: create a Histogram instance with a given resolution and max possible value for performance testing
add_values_to_histogram: add a numeric value to the histogram to record it in the appropriate bucket
get_histogram_data: get the histogram data as a HistogramData protobuf with buckets, min, max, sum, and count
merge_histogram_data: merge another HistogramData protobuf into the current histogram by combining buckets and statistics
reset_histogram: reset the histogram to its initial state clearing all recorded values and bucket counts
